headline: Six Fronts Intensify as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the map remains largely static, yet a half‑dozen sectors have sharpened dramatically. Weathered Expanse now leads the ledger with 51 ownership flips in the past day, Colonial dead climbing to 8,525 and Warden dead to 13,782 while 463 fresh troops arrived. Callahans Passage holds at 31 flips, its 24‑hour toll at 9,783 Colonial and 12,081 Warden casualties with 841 enlistees. Fishermans Row has become the newest hotspot, its flips rising to 32 centred on Eidolo, Black Well and nearby posts; losses stand at 387 Colonial and 528 Warden, enlistments 192. Stlican Shelf activity steadied at 18 flips, casualties slipping to 2,402 Colonial and 2,616 Warden, enlistments 277. Mooring County steadied at 12 flips, casualties falling to 5,861 Colonial and 7,042 Warden, enlistments 656. Stema Landing, previously quiet, now shows nine flips with modest losses of 24 Colonial and 13 Warden and 66 recruits. All other regions report no ownership changes, indicating the fighting remains concentrated on these six fronts.
